name: Lago di Braies loop (Pragser Wildsee)
why: An easy hour round the emerald lake under the Croda del Becco walls, with the wooden boathouse at one end and a scree beach at the other.
book: Free path. From 10 July to 10 September the road to the lake is closed to cars 9:30-16:00 unless you booked a parking slot online; otherwise take the bus from Dobbiaco or Villabassa (booking needed in peak season). Rowing boats are rented at the boathouse.
water: Drinking fountains and a bar at the hotel end; nothing along the far shore.
dangers: The west shore has some steps and roots: slippery when wet.
In winter the far shore is icy and the full loop is often closed.

points.name: Lago di Braies boathouse
points.note: 1,494 m, the wooden boathouse with the rowing boats, by the hotel. Go round clockwise: the east shore is flat, the west has the steps.

points.name: Lago di Braies south shore
points.note: The far end of the lake: a white gravel beach under the Croda del Becco, looking back at the hotel. Path 1 of the Alta Via 1 climbs from here.
